Privacy & artwork

Your selected export stays local

The viewer reads your HTML file in browser memory. It does not upload it, store it in browser storage, or send player names, account identifiers, purchases, sessions, or filenames to a server. Closing or refreshing the page clears the imported report. There are no accounts, analytics, ads, or browser-agent integrations.

Imported documents are parsed as inert content and converted into text. Their scripts, links, images, styles, and embedded pages are never activated. The data-viewing page blocks network connections through its Content Security Policy.

Automatically loaded game icons

When the site opens, an isolated loader reads Supercell’s public fan-kit catalog and loads the supported app icons from its Frontify image CDN. The request set is the same for everyone, regardless of their exported games. It cannot read the report. Requests omit cookies and referrer information. These services receive ordinary request information, including your IP address. Unknown games use local letter badges.

Images are held in memory for this visit and accompanied by links to their official fan-kit pages. Images, availability, and terms can change. If images are unavailable, the viewer quietly keeps working with local badges. No export contents or filenames are sent to the icon services.

Hosting and your browser

A website host receives ordinary requests for the site's public files. GitHub Pages logs visitor IP addresses for security. This is separate from your selected export, which is not uploaded. Links you open lead to other services with their own policies. Browser extensions, browser assistants with page access, and a compromised device are outside this app's control.

Independent project and image rights

Game Data Lens is unofficial and is not endorsed by Supercell. For more information, see Supercell’s Fan Content Policy. Game names and artwork belong to their respective owners. The icons come from Supercell’s official fan kit and are used under its conditional fan-content permission; they are not public-domain or unrestricted open-license images.

Artwork is used only to identify the supported games. The viewer is free. Its code license does not license third-party names or artwork. Check the linked fan-kit pages and Fan Content Policy before reusing icons. Neither a disclaimer nor dynamic loading guarantees approval from a rights holder.
